title: Standard WOFOST continuation-state inventory

persistent_committed_crop_state_common.name: crop_emerged
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.meaning: whether the actual WOFOST crop trajectory is active
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.update_cadence: lifecycle event, not a soil-water solver substep
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transaction_semantics: committed physical state; candidate-only mutation until F-KT commit

persistent_committed_crop_state_common.name: DVS
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.update_cadence: once per legacy daily WOFOST evolution update
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transition_logic: standard rate from update_dvs_rate; update DVS=min(DVS+dvr*delt,DVSEND) with legacy delt=1
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transaction_semantics: committed physical state; rejected crop event must not advance it

persistent_committed_crop_state_common.name: TSUM
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.units: degree C day under the qualified one-day legacy cadence
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.update_cadence: once per legacy daily WOFOST evolution update
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.continuation_role: prognostic and source-observable state for standard WOFOST; in the scoped standard equations it is not itself a feedback dependency for subsequent DVS rates
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transaction_semantics: committed crop state for faithful continuation/output; rejected event must not advance it

persistent_committed_crop_state_common.name: fl_anthesis
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.meaning: anthesis threshold has already been crossed
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.update_cadence: evaluated on the daily phenology-rate event
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transition_logic: when DVS+dvr >= 1 and the flag is false, set true and truncate dvr to 1-DVS
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.continuation_role: irreducible because it controls whether the DVS boundary correction is applied again
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transaction_semantics: transition must be candidate-local even though legacy update_dvs_rate mutates the saved flag

persistent_committed_crop_state_common.name: nofd
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.meaning: number of populated days in the running minimum-temperature history
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.update_cadence: once at the legacy day-start assimilation event
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transaction_semantics: must roll back with the crop owner; rejected/replayed events may not consume a history slot

persistent_committed_crop_state_common.name: atmin7[7]
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.meaning: minimum-temperature history used for the running low-temperature assimilation correction
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.update_cadence: once at the legacy day-start assimilation event
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transition_logic: shift prior entries 1:6 to 2:7 and insert current daily TMN at element 1
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.continuation_role: irreducible persistent climate-memory state across crop events
persistent_committed_crop_state_common.transaction_semantics: must be deep-copied/checkpointed and only published on crop-event commit

persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.name: vern
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.presence: only for standard WOFOST with IDSL=2
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.units: vernalization units as defined by VERNRTB/VERNBASE/VERNSAT
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.update_cadence: daily WOFOST evolution event while the IDSL=2 route exists
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.transaction_semantics: optional committed state; no allocation/storage burden for IDSL!=2

persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.name: fl_vernalised
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.presence: only for standard WOFOST with IDSL=2
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.meaning: vernalization is complete or has been forced complete at the critical DVS
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.transition_logic: can become true in update_dvs_rate at VERNDVS or after vern reaches VERNSAT
persistent_committed_crop_state_optional.transaction_semantics: candidate-local transition; rejected event must leave committed value unchanged

event_local_rates_or_intermediates.name: dtsum
event_local_rates_or_intermediates.reason: computed from current event forcing TAV and immutable DTSMTB before TSUM/DVS update

event_local_rates_or_intermediates.name: dvr
event_local_rates_or_intermediates.reason: computed from current DVS, daylength/vernalization state and current dtsum before the one event update

event_local_rates_or_intermediates.name: daylp
event_local_rates_or_intermediates.reason: legacy stores it between day-start assimilation and day-end phenology-rate calculation; no evidence requires persistence across accepted crop windows

event_local_rates_or_intermediates.name: WOFOST_rates
event_local_rates_or_intermediates.reason: growth, death, allocation and leaf-age rates are consumed to build the candidate state and need not survive an accepted crop event

diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.name: first_warning
diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.classification: diagnostic warning latch, not physical crop continuation state
diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.note: warning reproducibility may require diagnostics ownership, but it must not be promoted into physical crop state merely because legacy saves it

diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.name: DWRT/DWST/DWLV
diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.classification: standard-route cumulative output/diagnostic in this scoped sw_wofost=1 analysis
diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.note: no source-bound feedback into the scoped standard evolution was found; grass management is excluded and must be qualified separately

vernrate_reconciliation_hazard.name: vernrate
vernrate_reconciliation_hazard.source_observation: legacy declares vernrate SAVE. update_dvs_rate resets/assigns it only inside the .NOT.fl_vernalised branch. If fl_vernalised becomes true after vern reaches VERNSAT, a previously positive vernrate can remain saved and the following daily task-3 call still executes vern=vern+vernrate.
vernrate_reconciliation_hazard.physical_feedback_after_fl_vernalised: none found for subsequent standard-route DVS evolution because fl_vernalised bypasses the vernalization reduction
vernrate_reconciliation_hazard.observable_effect: vern itself is written by the legacy WOFOST output and can therefore continue to drift from the saved stale rate
vernrate_reconciliation_hazard.decision: DO_NOT_PROMOTE_VERNRATE_TO_PERSISTENT_PHYSICAL_STATE_YET; RECONCILE WHETHER THE LEGACY CARRYOVER IS AN ORACLE SEMANTIC TO_PRESERVE, A DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_EFFECT, OR A LEGACY_DEFECT BEFORE G03 CAN_PASS

transaction_boundary.required_atomicity: phenology/climate-memory, lifecycle and actual biomass must be part of the same candidate physical crop continuation for an admitted crop event

deferred_to_next_persisted_evidence: explicit day-start/day-end call and cadence contract
full transaction/event composition with root state
